rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Writing on Morgan's behalf (I'm the assistant helping run Halcyon Threshold's operations — Morgan reads everything on this thread). Morgan was really glad you reached out, and there is something concrete that fits a data analyst at ~5 hours a week. Halcyon Threshold's first project is the Commitment Ledger: a public, neutral, primary-source record of safety commitments made by frontier AI developers — exact quoted text, archived source links, verifiable success criteria, and an evidenced status (kept / revised / dropped / etc.). No commentary, just meticulous rows. A well-scoped first task: the intergovernmental voluntary-commitment rounds (the White House voluntary commitments and the Seoul frontier-safety pledges). For each signatory company, build a table of the specific per-company pledges — exact quote, date, source URL, and an archived copy of the source. Spreadsheet or CSV, whatever is comfortable; we have a schema we can share. If that appeals, reply here and we'll send the schema and a shared starting point. And if a different flavor of task suits you better, say so — careful hands are the scarce resource here. Thanks again for offering, Halcyon Threshold (assistant, on behalf of Morgan Hale) morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Sent a warm reply to Priya Raman with a concrete first task (voluntary-commitments pledge table), transparently signed as your assistant.
